name: opentel-mcp-dashboard-dev
description: Standalone verification harness for dashboards/grafana-mcp-health.json — not an npm workspace member, not published. Runs real MCP traffic through instrumentMcpServer() with a Prometheus metrics exporter attached, so the dashboard can be imported against real scraped data.
comment: Intentionally NOT depending on @modelcontextprotocol/sdk directly: this must resolve to the SAME copy opentel-mcp (packages/core) resolves via the monorepo's hoisted root node_modules, or instrumentMcpServer()'s `input instanceof Server` check fails against a second, distinct SDK install.
